proxy_law.accepted_relation: If the Operator names principal X but the immediate next structured speaker is full-name Y, the handoff remains source-supported only when Y's first source utterance explicitly binds Y as 'on for', 'sitting in for', or equivalent on-behalf relation to X. Canonical questioner name is Y. Operator-supplied affiliation of X does not automatically transfer to Y; affiliation remains unresolved unless Y's affiliation is independently stated in the same handoff/utterance.

structural_separator_law: All 110 adjudicated question handoffs are structural separators. The 9 unresolved questioner handoffs must still split neighboring Q&A windows so their source text cannot be merged into an adjacent accepted exchange, but they cannot mint a canonical qa_exchange. TFG-1 must preserve a typed separator/refusal state for these boundaries; it must not infer a person, silently discard the separator, or contaminate adjacent spans.
full_call_bar: The former >=12/16 non-empty call bar is superseded. It exceeds the independently adjudicated all-or-nothing source-clean ceiling. TFG-1 must produce non-empty deterministic reconstruction on all 10 source-clean calls. The remaining six calls must fail only for frozen source-identity/conflict reasons, never terminal-phrase format dependence, while their structural handoffs remain correctly separated.
boundary_bar: On the development corpus, structural boundary detection must recover all 110 adjudicated handoffs with zero opening/queue/closing false positives. Of those, 101 must resolve a source-supported direct/proxy questioner according to the frozen law; the 9 unresolved cases must remain refused/separator-only.
